periods.label: 以晓学园撕裂联盟关系的首相
periods.species: human / Blazer or human politician (not clarified here)

status.current: uses Akatsuki Academy and Seven Stars to push Japan toward breaking from the International Mage-Knight League

relationships.shinguji-kurono: Former teacher of Kurono, now political enemy; he still calls her by her old surname Takizawa.
relationships.ouma-kurogane: Akatsuki's A-rank representative under his project.
relationships.reizen-hiraga: One of the Rebellion-linked Akatsuki representatives used in the tournament plan.

periods.summary: Tsukikage's establishment of National Akatsuki Academy splits Japanese public opinion and makes Seven Stars a political referendum on whether Japan should remain under the International Mage-Knight League. In a smoking-room conversation with Kurono, he admits that reclaiming educational authority is only the pretext: his true goal is to create an irreparable rift between Japan and the League, even by using illegal means and Rebellion-linked fighters. He believes Japan should leave the League and recover national autonomy and glory.

key_events.summary: His Akatsuki declaration turns Seven Stars into a national political crisis.
Admits to Kurono that he wants Japan to sever ties with the League.

periods.time: Night before the semifinals through Akatsuki's tournament elimination
periods.label: 把厄运秘密交给一辉的首相
periods.occupation: prime minister; political operator; school founder

status.current: Akatsuki representatives are eliminated, yet his deeper motive and Blazer ability remain undisclosed
status.mystery: knows Amane's hidden past despite causality obstacles

personality.summary: Calm, affable and opaque; he advances political and personal goals through selective revelations and plausible ambiguity.

abilities_owned: unknown causality/knowledge-related Blazer ability suspected but not revealed

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Approaches Ikki at night and gives him Amane's true name and history, allegedly to drag Amane into the semifinal.
relationships.amane-shinomiya: Predicts Amane's withdrawal attempt and exposes his hidden past after Amane tries to betray Akatsuki's interests.
relationships.nene-saikyo: Questioned by Nene about whether he meant to save Amane and about how he obtained the information.
relationships.ouma-kurogane: Akatsuki A-rank hope who loses the semifinal to Stella.

periods.summary: Tsukikage appears in the park after Stella leaves Ikki's training. He says that in the present state Ikki will almost certainly not fight Amane, because Amane intends to withdraw, and offers the information needed to provoke him. He reveals Amane's former name, Amamiya Shion, and the life of isolation, abuse, and self-abandonment produced by Nameless Glory. Ikki recognizes that Tsukikage is designing either Amane or Ikki, but still uses the information. After Akatsuki is eliminated, Nene confronts Tsukikage in the hospital corridor, suspecting that he wanted Ikki to save Amane and that only a stronger causality-related ability could uncover such a past; Tsukikage refuses a clear answer and says he will reveal the truth in a proper place later.

key_events.summary: Gives Ikki Amane's secret past before the semifinal.
Is questioned by Nene about his motives and unknown ability after Akatsuki's defeat.
